risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified but reflects materially weakening performance, including a 7.1% sales decline, severe gross-margin compression, sharply lower operating income, and a net loss. Management presents recovery expectations for 2023, but these depend on moderating freight and product-cost inflation, improved inventory management, and execution of strategic initiatives. Borrowings, lease-related judgments, uncertain tax outcomes, and extensive forward-looking assumptions remain notable credit risks.
